title: Move-Out Accounting Note: The Move-Out Utility Payment on a Utility Account in Final Billing
content:
# The Move-Out Utility Payment — Utility Services Program

**What it is.** The move-out utility payment is the part of the final utility balance of a Utility Services Program account in final billing that the former resident pays in person because the security deposit is not expected to reach it. The resident pays it with an instrument of their own, and whatever is not paid is carried into the final account statement under the Security Deposit Account charter. It applies to every account in final billing, whether or not a line on it stands under a dispute.

**When the part paid in person is settled.** The part of the final utility balance paid in person is fixed only after the account in final billing carries its package fee line for the final period. Before the part paid in person is worked out, the final period's water usage above its final water allowance must stand on the account as a water overage line. The part paid in person is not worked out until the final period's electricity usage above its final electricity allowance stands on the account as an electricity overage line.

## The payment: `pay_moveout_utility_share_762d5a93`

The payment is the former resident's own act. The agent unlocks `pay_moveout_utility_share_762d5a93` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it with an instrument of their own. One call records one payment received today for the amount given, lowers the account's outstanding utility balance by that amount and issues the payment a confirmation number; afterwards the payment appears among the account's lines and the lower utility balance is visible.

### Parameters

- `utility_account_id` — the reference number of the former resident's utility services account, as the resident services agent reads it from the utility account lookup (identifier).
- `amount` — the amount paid, in US dollars with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; always positive.
- `payment_method` — exactly one of:

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ach_one_time` | a one-time bank transfer from a checking or savings account |
| `debit_card` | a payment by debit card |
| `credit_card` | a payment by credit card |
| `money_order` | a money order mailed with its serial number |
| `cashiers_check` | a cashier's check mailed with its serial number |
| `ach_autopay` | reserved for the recurring automatic bank draft; never used for a payment made here |
| `deposit_application` | reserved for applying the security deposit at final accounting; never used for a payment made here |
| `not_applicable` | marks lines that are not payments; never used for a payment |

### Receipt

The tool returns `status` (the string "received"), `bill_id` (the reference number of the payment line), `payment_reference` (the confirmation number issued), `amount` (2 decimal places), `payment_method` (the instrument recorded) and `balance_due` (the account's outstanding utility balance after the payment, 2 decimal places).
